notes.title: DEMO RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 A New Era Begins 🔥[/h1][p]We’ve been listening… and we’re ready.[/p][p]Thanks to your amazing feedback and support, our game has undergone a complete transformation. [b]The name has changed. The theme has evolved.[/b] We’re diving deep into a [b]dark medieval fantasy world[/b]—one filled with mystery, danger, and legends waiting to be uncovered.[/p][h3]🛡️ [b]New name. New art. New identity.[/b]
Every corner of the game has been reimagined to bring you a richer, more immersive experience. From stunning new visuals to deeper lore, we’ve pushed forward because [i]you[/i] asked for more—and we heard you.[/h3][p]This isn’t just a game for us. It’s a game for [b]the community[/b].
We’re building this together—with passion, with purpose, and with your voice at the heart of it all.[/p][p]💥 And now, it’s time to show you what we’ve been working on.[/p][h3]🧪 [b]THE DEMO DROPS THIS FRIDAY – 12:00 PM GMT[/b] 🧪
Get ready to step into the world we’ve crafted for you.[/h3][p]Mark your calendars.
Sharpen your blades.
Darkness is coming.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294894/c106070373113b317993705f2eb8753b4530d7e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: PLAY TEST NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[h3][b]Exciting News! [/b][/h3]🎮✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294894/8f9e76e6dc2413a11e8d24e1456c375de7c78059.gif[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce that a playtest for our upcoming game, Low Poly Stories: Mist, is now available on Steam! This is your chance to dive into the eerie world we've been crafting and help shape its future.

As a small, passionate team, we value community feedback deeply. By participating in the playtest, you'll play a pivotal role in improving Low Poly Mist, ensuring it’s the best it can be when fully launched. Here's what you can expect:

🕹 Immersive Gameplay: Experience the haunting atmosphere of a world consumed by a mysterious fog.
🛠 Your Input Matters: Spot bugs, suggest improvements, and let us know what you love or would tweak.
💡 Shaping the Experience: From gameplay mechanics to narrative flow, your feedback will help us refine every detail.

We can't wait to hear your thoughts, stories, and discoveries. Let’s build something unforgettable together!

➡ Join the Playtest on Steam Now and help us bring Low Poly Stories: Mist to life! Thank you for your support; we couldn’t do this without you.

Stay tuned for updates and happy exploring! 🌫✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294894/95138ae5610fbc7a39b9bd4be96b6cf6746ed515.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Reveal and demo Info
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Low Poly Stories: Mist[/b][/u][/h3]

Hey Guys, Low poly stories: Mist will be an open world survival game, with a dark fantasy tone, your goal will be to discover the secrets behind the mist in a magical land, there will be magic, guns melee weapons, you name it, we will put a lot of effort to create this game for you, if everything go as planned the full game will be release at the end of 2026, we will focus a lot in history telling to make the game more interesting, also survival elements, we hope to receive a lot of feedback so we can deliver the game with zero bugs, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294894/2744da28eedb849fdfef5381cfc1c6e4dada28d5.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Demo[/b][/u][/h3]

We have demo of the game readyfor you to test! it will be available on november so you can test the first chapter of Low Poly Stories: mist, I ma sure you will find it interesting!
